Just checked my #docker containers, thanks to @linuxundich@social.anoxinon.de. As a result, I learned that the @wallabag@fosstodon.org image on docker hub was last updated more than a year ago and therefore is vulnerable. So in case you are running #wallabag, look out for the update.
